metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Settings app to Power section and use gsettings commands in terminal
metadata.explanation: Same-app objective: change Screen Blank timeout to Never (idle-delay=0) instead of the current 5 minutes (300s). Evaluator reads org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay and checks it equals 0. Initial state (idle-delay=300) fails.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay via gsettings, which is the canonical GNOME setting for Screen Blank timeout.
Parsing logic correctly handles 'uint32 N' output format by splitting and taking the last token.
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('expected_idle_delay', 0)) since expected.type='rule' passes rules dict directly — no parameter handling error.
Expected value of 0 correctly corresponds to 'Never' for Screen Blank in GNOME Power settings.
Initial config sets idle-delay=300, ensuring initial state fails the evaluator (negative control resistance).
Single-requirement instruction is fully covered by a single getter+metric check.
No postconfig needed as getter reads state via bash command, independent of UI state.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor robustness: wrap int(parts[-1]) in a try/except to return -1 on parse failure instead of raising an exception.
